releases.changelog: TinyG 450.01 (edge-next pre-release, built from edge-next 425fa92e): every fix made on edge-next since edge-0.97 build 449.01 (158 firmware fixes, 5 features), among them the fast position-keeping limit stop (E031), lost serial input never running as a corrupted move (E162), G10 persistence, and the empty-arc cycle end. Later builds (450.02, ...) supersede it. Flashing it resets every setting to the defaults (the build number changes): Run restores your backed-up settings afterwards.

TinyG 440.21 (pre-release, the 440 line): the first CI-built release of the master branch, published on GitHub Releases. An older build than the edge-next bench firmware. Flashing it resets every setting to the defaults (the build number changes): Run restores your backed-up settings afterwards.
SIMULATOR ONLY. Simulated update for the fake-serial suite (same EEPROM layout). Not firmware: never flashed to a real board.
SIMULATOR ONLY. Simulated update with a new EEPROM layout: the board loads its defaults on first boot (switch type and switch modes change). Not firmware: never flashed to a real board.
